//: services/ai-rag — AI/RAG microservice. Consumes `ai.diagnosis.requested` from Kafka, retrieves relevant clinical context from ChromaDB (vector store), generates a diagnosis via Ollama (Llama-3-8B local LLM), and emits `ai.diagnosis.completed` + `audit.event`. Built on NestJS 10 (Express platform) so it shares DI/lifecycle conventions with the API gateway.
name: @caregiver/ai-rag
//dependencies: NestJS 10 on Express as the application host (DI + lifecycle hooks). ChromaDB for vector storage / similarity search. Ollama reached via its REST API (native fetch) for local LLM inference. KafkaJS (via @caregiver/kafka) for event consumption/production. Drizzle ORM + postgres driver (via @caregiver/db) to update the ai_diagnoses table through the diagnosis lifecycle. reflect-metadata + rxjs required by NestJS runtime.
//devDependencies: Node types + tsx for dev-mode transpilation + TypeScript + vitest for unit tests.
